title: Didagou Raises Multi-Ten-Million RMB Pre-A from OXYZ Seafirst for TikTok Ecommerce Data
summary: On Apr 20, 2023, TikTok (overseas Douyin) ecommerce service Didagou (Xiamen Time Dominion Tech) raised a multi-ten-million RMB Pre-A from OXYZ Seafirst Capital. Proceeds: systematize SEA managed ops + platform build.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · May 11, 2023

On Apr 20, 2023, TikTok (overseas Douyin) ecommerce service Didagou (Xiamen Time Dominion Tech) raised a multi-ten-million RMB Pre-A from OXYZ Seafirst Capital. Proceeds: systematize SEA managed ops + platform build.

Context: TikTok ecommerce shifting — (1) cross-border toward “full custody” (merchant supply; platform traffic/ops); (2) TikTok Shop US open within year; BR/ES/IT/AU/NZ/FR/MENA timing unclear. Founded early 2020 — third-party TK data (social product-pick content, Shop sales, Ads). PH managed ops for beauty/personal-care (e.g. Metoo → multi-million RMB monthly GMV). ~40 staff half data / half ops; monthly revenue multi-million RMB, ~70% from ops.

~100k registered users: >50% EU/US Amazon sellers; >30% SEA cross-border; >10% DTC; thousands paid members/community. Founder Victor Yang: deepen TikTok data + overseas push; 1–2yr SEA six-country full managed coverage. TikTok ecommerce early vs Douyin. Differentiator vs peers: Shop closed-loop data plus non-transactional creator UGC for social selection; early entry + traffic lead. Data = public; high-velocity shops prioritized via dynamic compute. Sales mix ~60% short video / 40% live; high-margin SKUs (3C, beauty) fit. Challenges: burst GMV stress on fulfillment/cash; localization barrier — overseas warehouses, creators, MCNs help.

— END —
